Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time to walk through CloudBridge's containerized inference use case today. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goal: lower per-token inference costs for your paid tier while keeping p95 latency under 200ms for interactive flows.
- Current blockers: multi-tenant routing complexity, and needing a predictable SLA for customer-facing endpoints.
- Redwood fit: our Dedicated pools + routing policies can give predictable throughput and fallbacks; we also have a couple of quantized model variants that tend to hit your cost targets.

Next step: we recommend a technical deep dive / demo with our Solutions Engineer (Mateo) + your lead engineer to validate integration approach and confirm perf expectations. Proposed slots (all PT):
- Wed Jul 29, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu Jul 30, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Fri Jul 31, 10:00–11:00 PT

Please let me know which of these works or share a few windows that fit Tom / your eng team. I'll loop in Mateo and our product lead (Jonas) once we lock a time.

Attaching a brief mutual action plan and a suggested demo agenda to make the deep dive as efficient as possible.

Attachments: Redwood_CloudBridge_MAP_v1.2.pdf (PDF, 48KB); proposed-demo-agenda.docx (DOCX, 12KB)

Thanks —
